story_notes: First-frame preview uses a canvas extract helper in finish-photos-ui. Preview runs in parallel with multipart upload; Submit stays disabled until upload completes (see US-11 / AC-39).

tasks.title: First-frame preview on file pick
tasks.description: In Upload new mode, extract and render the first decodable frame immediately after file selection, before multipart upload completes. Replacing the file updates the preview (AC-03).
tasks.acceptance: AC-01, AC-03, AC-04, AC-05 — preview on pick; no preview for existing/Dropbox modes
decisions: Use canvas first-frame extract helper (new module) — not a third-party thumbnail library
Preview updates on file replace; existing/Dropbox modes stay without preview
